description: This file defines the interface and class for serial port communication within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes enums for configuration parameters, class declarations for SerialPort with methods for opening, closing, configuring, and data transfer, and platform-specific code for Windows and Linux.

classes.name: SerialPort
classes.description: A class representing a serial port interface supporting configuration, data transfer, and platform-specific handling for Windows and Linux.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison based on the internal descriptor handle.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison based on the internal descriptor handle.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the serial port is currently open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the serial port is currently closed.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the serial port has encountered an error.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the serial port buffers.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier (port name).

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier (port name).

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the serial port with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the serial port with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the serial port (implementation-specific).

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the serial port (to be implemented in derived classes).

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the serial port (to be implemented in derived classes).

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Configures the serial port with detailed parameters.

methods.name: SetBaudRate
methods.description: Sets the baud rate of the serial port.

methods.name: SendBreak
methods.description: Sends a break signal on the serial port.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Initializes the serial port object with buffer sizes.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Applies the current configuration settings to the hardware.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Marks the port as opened and updates state.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Marks the port as closed and releases resources.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for the port to close within a timeout.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the port (platform-specific).

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the port (platform-specific).

methods.name: Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the handle to the port (platform-specific).

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Aligns the buffer for Linux or Windows handle.
